hero.title: With Future Technologies
hero.subtitle: "MealAI, which brings traditional kitchen habits together with the technology of the future, is not just a recipe application, but the next-generation operating system of your kitchen."

features.title: Data-Driven, Personalized Kitchen for You
features.subtitle: "An approach that goes beyond static lists and deeply analyzes every detail from your allergens to your diet goals."

inventory.title: Smart Inventory Management
inventory.desc: Forget old-school notebooks and lists. Easily manage your inventory digitally and keep your shared kitchen in sync with family, roommates, or colleagues.

shopping.title: Analysis-Oriented Approach
shopping.desc: An analysis structure that examines your past consumption, preferences, and physical traits; offering personalized guidance with charts and smart calculations.

recommendation.title: AI-Powered Recommendation
recommendation.desc: An AI-powered system that analyzes every detail from allergens to diet goals, providing ideal recommendations considering your current inventory.

group.title: Digitalized Kitchen Experience
group.desc: Your smartest kitchen partner that manages your kitchen with data, personalizes every meal, and digitalizes your nutritional habits with an analytical approach.

cta_final.title: Digitalize Your Kitchen Today
cta_final.desc: Meet MealAI and start managing your kitchen with data right away.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To ensure everyone has a healthy and sustainable diet by blending traditional kitchen habits with modern technology.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To become a global platform that prevents food waste and maximizes individual health by becoming the operating system of kitchens with our AI assistant.

story.title: Our Story
story.content: MealAI set out to make time spent in the kitchen more efficient and to find the healthiest, inventory-based, and personalized answer to the question 'what should I cook today?'

welcome: Welcome to AI-Powered Meal Recommendation Platform!
